heading: Composition with `realtime`
text:
### Composition with `realtime` [LDTL.2.4]

| With `dynamic_ttl: true` and | Effect |
|---|---|
| `realtime: true` | Deadline heap in RT mode. The engine must reserve and size the deadline heap ([LDTL.4.2]) during INIT, and must check its capacity at the transition to LIVE. No new RT pre-conditions. |
| `realtime: true`, `linear_scan: false` | All three constraints apply independently. |
